title: Data analysis evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence explains the business question, cleaning and analysis steps, findings, and the decision supported.

title: SQL evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence shows candidate-written queries, joins, aggregation, filtering, validation, and resulting reports or datasets.

title: Python evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence includes readable code, dependencies, reproduction instructions, tests or validation, and a clear contribution statement.

title: Statistics evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence states the statistical question, assumptions, method, interpretation, uncertainty, and limitations.

title: Machine learning evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence covers data preparation, leakage-safe validation, a baseline, model selection, evaluation metrics, error analysis, and reproducible inference.

title: RAG evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence documents ingestion, chunking, embeddings, vector retrieval, reranking, grounded output, citations, fallback behavior, and evaluation.

title: LLM application evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence shows prompt and schema design, model selection, validation, hallucination controls, fallback handling, evaluation, and responsible AI safeguards.

title: Power BI evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence shows the data model, transformations, DAX, dashboard decisions, validation, users, and the decision supported.

title: Backend API evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence shows endpoint design, input validation, authentication decisions, error handling, tests, documentation, and deployment behavior.

title: Project management evidence standard
standard: Strong evidence shows planning, ownership, stakeholder communication, risk management, delivery tracking, decisions, and measurable outcomes.
